question: Can one unchanged Adva research data-machine program interpret multiple exact arithmetic trees, with independently replayed execution and budget-preserving suspension?
level: Research-only language implementation; not PSC0 promotion or self interpretation
imports: Rust remains the sole native semantic authority (ADR 0001)
Research 0137 identifies finite code data, structural inspection and bounded control as missing interfaces
Signed 64-bit checked integer operations are the declared exact scalar domain; overflow is rejection
The new register/tree machine has separate versioned semantics and no native SourceId/OccurrenceId allocation
interface: Adva bytecode specifies object-language tag dispatch, explicit work/value stacks and arithmetic selection. Rust supplies generic typed data/stack/integer/control instructions. A separate Python instruction interpreter and a direct arithmetic-tree oracle check the results.
protected: Program, input, instruction profile and lifetime fuel remain fixed across continuation
A checkpoint is accepted only after complete native replay against independently supplied context
All fetched instructions, including a failing instruction, consume one lifetime fuel unit
Quantum suspension, lifetime exhaustion, semantic rejection and successful return remain distinct
Every instruction location and complete state digest remain in the replayable trace
No f64 oracle, hidden object-language evaluator, automatic fuel refill or borrowed PSC0 certificate

forms: binary op over a literal and a binary literal expression

preflight: Rust unit and CLI engineering controls, at most 60 seconds per invocation and four invocations before a revised engineering decision. Compilation/formatting are separate finite build gates. Preserve failures; no failed full campaign is silently restarted.
exit: Stop on first full-campaign mismatch, refusal-control failure, resource limit or publication failure. Retain the failure and do not publish a positive claim. Success requires all declared cases and two matching fresh-process results.
limits: No self interpreter, universality, specializer, Q4/M6 execution, native diagram correspondence, optimal-machine Omega or speedup claim. CI regressions are separate finite checks, not new research searches.
